breadcrumb: Std 6 Social Science (English) — History Unit 4: Ancient Cities of Tamilagam — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: Mesopotamian civilisation is the earliest civilisation in the world. It is 6500 years old.

en.q: The earliest civilisation in the world, about 6500 years old, is the ______ civilisation.
options: Indus Valley civilisation of north-west India
en.explanation: The Mesopotamian civilisation is about 6500 years old.

ta.q: உலகின் மிகப் பழமையான, 6500 ஆண்டுகள் பழமையான நாகரிகம் ______ நாகரிகம்.

questions.quote: Poompuhar was also known by names such as Puhar and Kaveripoompattinam. It served as the port of the early Chola kingdom.

en.q: Poompuhar, the port of the early Cholas, was also known as ______.
options: Korkai, the Pandya port on the east coast
en.explanation: Poompuhar was also called Puhar and Kaveripoompattinam.

ta.q: ஆதிச் சோழர்களின் துறைமுகமான பூம்புகார் வேறு எவ்வாறு அழைக்கப்பட்டது?

questions.quote: It is a coastal town near the present-day Mayiladuthurai and is located where the river Cauvery drains into the sea.

en.q: Poompuhar is a coastal town near present-day ______.
en.explanation: It is near Mayiladuthurai where the Cauvery meets the sea.

ta.q: பூம்புகார் இன்றைய எந்த ஊருக்கு அருகிலுள்ள கடற்கரை நகரம்?
ta.explanation: காவிரி கடலில் கலக்கும் இடமாகிய மயிலாடுதுறை அருகில் உள்ளது.

questions.quote: The lead female character of Silappathikaram is Kannagi. Her father is Maanaigan. Sea traders are known by the name Maanaigan. The male character Kovalan's father is Maasathuvan.

en.explanation: Kannagi's father was Maanaigan (a sea trader); Kovalan's father was Maasathuvan (a big trader).

ta.explanation: கண்ணகியின் தந்தை மாநாய்கன்; கோவலனின் தந்தை மாசாத்துவான்.

questions.quote: The traders of Poompuhar were known for their honesty and integrity. Pattinappaalai states that 'selling any commodity at a higher price was considered bad'.

en.q: The traders of Poompuhar were known for ______.
options: hoarding grains in times of famine
honesty and fair prices in selling
avoiding any trade with foreign lands
charging very high prices for goods
en.explanation: They sold goods at legitimate prices; selling at a higher price was considered bad.

ta.explanation: நியாய விலையில் விற்றனர்; அதிக விலைக்கு விற்பது தவறு எனக் கருதப்பட்டது.

questions.quote: Horses were imported by sea. Pepper was procured through the land route. Gold that came from Vadamalai was polished and exported to the overseas countries. Sandal from Western Ghats, pearls from southern sea, corals from eastern sea and food items from Eelam were imported.

en.q: According to Pattinappaalai, which item was brought to Poompuhar from the eastern sea?
en.explanation: Sandal came from the Western Ghats, pearls from the southern sea, corals from the eastern sea.

ta.q: பட்டினப்பாலையின்படி பூம்புகாருக்குக் கிழக்குக் கடலிலிருந்து வந்த பொருள் எது?
ta.explanation: சந்தனம் மேற்குத் தொடர்ச்சி மலையிலிருந்தும், முத்து தென்கடலிலிருந்தும், பவளம் கிழக்குக் கடலிலிருந்தும் வந்தன.

questions.quote: Puhar was a busy port up to 200 AD(CE). It might have been either washed away by sea or destroyed by big shore waves.

en.q: Puhar remained a busy port up to about ______.
en.explanation: Puhar was a busy port up to 200 AD(CE) before it was probably destroyed by the sea.

ta.q: புகார் ஏறத்தாழ எக்காலம் வரை பரபரப்பான துறைமுகமாக இருந்தது?
ta.explanation: பொ.ஆ. 200 வரை புகார் சிறந்த துறைமுகம்; பின்னர் கடல் கோளால் அழிந்திருக்கலாம்.

questions.quote: Its antiquity can be understood from the sobriquet 'Sangam Valartha Nagaram' it has earned. Forty-nine poets were associated with the last Sangam.

en.q: How many poets were associated with the last Sangam of Madurai?
en.explanation: Forty-nine poets were associated with the last Sangam.

ta.q: மதுரையின் கடைசிச் சங்கத்தோடு தொடர்புடைய புலவர்கள் எத்தனை பேர்?

questions.quote: Ahil, fragrant wood, was brought from Port Thondi to Madurai.

en.q: Ahil, a fragrant wood, was brought to Madurai from the port of ______.
en.explanation: Ahil was brought from Port Thondi to Madurai.

ta.q: நறுமண மரமான அகில் மதுரைக்கு எந்தத் துறைமுகத்திலிருந்து கொண்டுவரப்பட்டது?

questions.quote: Chanakya, Chandragupta's minister, makes a mention of Madurai in his book, Arthasastra.

en.q: Madurai is mentioned by Chanakya in his book ______.
en.explanation: Chanakya mentions Madurai in the Arthasastra.

ta.q: சாணக்கியர் தம் எந்த நூலில் மதுரையைக் குறிப்பிடுகிறார்?

questions.quote: In the moat around the town, tunnels had been constructed in such a way that even elephants could comfortably enter.

en.q: A moat around Madurai had tunnels so constructed that even ______ could comfortably enter.
en.explanation: Tunnels in the moat were built so that even elephants could enter.

ta.q: மதுரையைச் சுற்றியிருந்த அகழியில் சுரங்கங்கள் ______ கூட எளிதாக நுழையும்படி அமைக்கப்பட்டிருந்தன.
ta.explanation: அகழியில் யானைகள் எளிதாக நுழையும்படி சுரங்கங்கள் இருந்தன.

questions.quote: Kanchi: Several schools were established in great numbers for the first time in Kancheepuram. Jains studied in Jainapalli, and Buddhists studied in Viharas.

en.q: Where did the Buddhists study in ancient Kanchi?
en.explanation: Jains studied in Jainapalli and Buddhists in Viharas.

ta.q: பண்டைய காஞ்சியில் பௌத்தர்கள் கல்வி கற்ற இடம் எது?

questions.quote: The Chinese traveller Hieun Tsang who studied at Nalanda University visited Kanchi to pursue his further studies.

en.q: The Chinese traveller who studied at Nalanda and visited Kanchi for further studies was ______.
en.explanation: Hiuen Tsang visited Kanchi ('Kadigai') for further studies.

ta.q: நாளந்தாவில் பயின்று மேல்படிப்புக்காகக் காஞ்சிக்கு வந்த சீனப் பயணி யார்?

questions.quote: The Buddhist monk Manimegalai spent the last part of her life at Kanchi. Kanchi is also known as the temples city. During the Pallava period, a large number of cave temples were built.

en.q: Kanchi is also known as the ______ city.
en.explanation: Kanchi is known as the temples city; Pallavas built many cave temples.

ta.explanation: காஞ்சி கோயில் நகரம்; பல்லவர் காலத்தில் குடைவரைக் கோவில்கள் கட்டப்பட்டன.

questions.quote: Kanchi is the oldest town in Thondai Nadu. Hundreds of lakes were created for storing water around the town of Kanchi.

en.q: Which is the oldest town in Thondai Nadu?
en.explanation: Kanchi is the oldest town in Thondai Nadu.

ta.q: தொண்டை நாட்டின் மிகப் பழமையான நகரம் எது?

questions.quote: Chola Nadu - sorudaithu (rice); Pandya Nadu - muthudaithu (pearls); Chera Nadu - vezhamudaithu (elephants); Thondai Nadu - Saandrorudaithu (scholars)

en.q: 'Muthudaithu' (pearls in abundance) is the saying associated with which Tamil kingdom?
en.explanation: Chola Nadu - sorudaithu; Pandya Nadu - muthudaithu; Chera Nadu - vezhamudaithu; Thondai Nadu - saandrorudaithu.

ta.q: 'முத்துடைத்து' (முத்து மிகுதி) எனும் சிறப்புக் கூற்று எந்த நாட்டுக்குரியது?
ta.explanation: சோழ நாடு சோறுடைத்து; பாண்டிய நாடு முத்துடைத்து; சேர நாடு வேழமுடைத்து; தொண்டை நாடு சான்றோருடைத்து.

questions.quote: Thondai Nadu - Present-day Kancheepuram, Dharmapuri, Tiruvallur, Tiruvannamalai, Vellore and northern parts of Villupuram districts. Chola Nadu - Present-day Thanjavur, Tiruvarur, Nagai, Trichy and Pudukkottai districts.

en.q: Which of the following districts belonged to Chola Nadu?
en.explanation: Chola Nadu: Thanjavur, Tiruvarur, Nagai, Trichy and Pudukkottai.

ta.q: பின்வரும் மாவட்டங்களுள் சோழ நாட்டைச் சேர்ந்தது எது?
ta.explanation: சோழ நாடு: தஞ்சாவூர், திருவாரூர், நாகை, திருச்சி, புதுக்கோட்டை.
